handoff: 1 blocking: norn-qa's description lacks the pointer to norn-qa-person the spec asks for (W7). Minor: lowercase 'nothing' in norn-slice:67; norn-fsd-round description lost its current-round bound. Everything else matches the proposals; unit tier and typecheck green.

findings.title: norn-qa's description does not point to norn-qa-person
findings.detail:
The spec's Wanted list asks for "norn-qa's description pointing QA-with-a-person to norn-qa-person", and SUMMARY.md's cross-cutting list (line 39) says: norn-qa description: "QA with a person is norn-qa-person". The description at line 3 ends with "Not for finding a bug's cause; use norn-diagnose." and has no such pointer; the pointer is only in the body (line 8). No lint limits the description (assets.test.ts:245 only asks for more than 40 characters), so nothing blocks the change. The same applies to the copy, .agents/skills/norn-qa/SKILL.md:3.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Append e.g. "QA alongside a person is norn-qa-person." to the description in the source, then refresh the .agents copy.

findings.title: A sentence starts lowercase after the checks fix
findings.detail:
"…exits non-zero on failure. nothing runs them for the implementer…". The copy in .agents/skills has the same text. Line 8 also says the frontmatter "is run exactly as written", which reads oddly next to line 67 saying nothing runs `checks`.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Capitalise 'Nothing'; consider rewording line 8 to 'read exactly as written'.

findings.title: The description lost its 'to the end of their round' bound
findings.detail:
The old description said "supervise, deliver or babysit named norn stories to the end of their round". The new one says "Use when asked to supervise, deliver or babysit named stories." It still says "Not for chaining rounds; use /norn-fsd", but "deliver" now overlaps norn-fsd's issue-to-merge job, and norn-fsd is not model-invocable.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Say 'deliver or babysit named stories through their current round'.

findings.title: The example criteria entry is duplicated from norn-qa
findings.detail:
Step 6 repeats the 'AC2 fail, buy milk p1 on /today' example from norn-qa, though it already says 'the same shape norn-qa writes'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop the example and keep the pointer.

findings.title: The fallback seam conflicts with the Done line's 'agreed seam' (already on main)
findings.detail:
Step 3 allows 'the highest existing seam', but Done (line 30) asks for a test 'at an agreed seam'. main has the same wording, so this change did not introduce it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: say 'agreed or fallback seam' in Done.
